items.title: DNA shaper steers nervous system development
items.summary: A study of worms finds a protein that helps shape the structure of the genome is critical for establishing the identity of some neurons.

items.title: Mathematical framework connects biological principles to manufacturable, adaptive materials
items.summary: The new framework could streamline the design process of robotic grippers or aerospace components that exhibit complex behaviors found in nature.
items.zh: 数学框架将生物学原理与可制造的适应性材料联系起来

items.title: MIT engineers connect bacteria to create living transistors
items.summary: By wiring together colonies of these bacteria, the researchers built circuits that can perform complicated calculations.
items.zh: 麻省理工学院的工程师将细菌连接起来创造活的晶体管

items.title: Snail slime does many jobs thanks to calcium
items.summary: Snails have five distinct types of mucus, each with its own job. The mollusks tweak calcium secretions to get the chemical mixture just right.
items.zh: 蜗牛粘液富含钙，可以发挥多种作用

items.title: Theory of Fluids Enters the 21st Century
items.summary: From the 1800s to the early 2000s, physicists used the same theory to understand the behavior of fluids. Now, using a modern insight, they have redefined fluids from the bottom up. The post Theory of Fluids Enters the 21st Century first appeared on Quanta Magazine
items.zh: 流体理论进入 21 世纪

items.title: 1,700-year-old church discovered under a lake in Turkey may be the location of the First Council of Nicaea — but other experts disagree
items.summary: A small church discovered beneath a larger one may have hosted one of the most important meetings in the history of Christianity, but some scholars not involved with the excavation disagree.
items.zh: 土耳其湖下发现的拥有 1700 年历史的教堂可能是第一次尼西亚公会议的所在地，但其他专家不同意

items.title: The COVID-19 vaccine may offer brain cancer patients a surprise benefit
items.summary: A recent shot of the COVID-19 vaccine doubled survival time in glioblastoma patients who had undergone tumor biopsy or surgery.
items.zh: COVID-19 疫苗可能会给脑癌患者带来意想不到的好处

items.title: Low-fat vegan diet helps people lose weight without eating less
items.summary: A low-fat vegan diet may help people lose weight without counting calories, shrinking portions, or feeling constantly hungry. items.zh: 低脂纯素饮食帮助人们无需少吃就能减肥

items.title: Skeleton with 167 fractures discovered at Scottish castle may have been first victim of Edward I's 'War Wolf' trebuchet
items.summary: Dozens of fractures in a medieval skeleton found buried near a castle suggest the person may have been killed by a direct trebuchet hit.
items.zh: 苏格兰城堡发现的有167处骨折的骨骼可能是爱德华一世“战狼”投石机的第一个受害者

items.summary: Astronomers may finally have a clue to what happens to the mysterious “little red dots” that crowded the early universe. items.zh: 韦伯神秘的小红点可能隐藏着整个星系

items.summary: Scientists are searching some of Earth’s oldest rocks for tiny fossils that could reveal how simple microbial life made the extraordinary leap toward plants, animals, and other complex organisms. Solving that ancient mystery may also help determine whether complex life could emerge on worlds beyond
items.zh: 17 亿年前的微小化石可以揭示复杂生命的起源

items.title: Fire-flame vessel: An exquisitely crafted 4,500-year-old pot from a mysterious culture in Japan

items.zh: 火焰容器：来自日本神秘文化的 4500 年前的精美锅具

items.title: Flexible brain circuits can switch between different tasks
items.summary: Neuroscientists have discovered circuits in the prefrontal cortex that can be repurposed to store different types of information.
items.zh: 灵活的大脑回路可以在不同的任务之间切换

items.title: Elon Musk and Sam Altman claim we've reached the AI singularity. But how would we even know that happened?
items.summary: Scientists suggest it could take decades to achieve superintelligent AI, and doing so still depends on hypothetical breakthroughs. So why do some suggest we're already there?
items.zh: 埃隆·马斯克和萨姆·奥尔特曼声称我们已经达到了人工智能奇点。但我们怎么知道这件事发生了呢？

items.title: Scientists turn DNA into a memory device that uses 100x less power
items.summary: Researchers combined synthetic DNA with a semiconductor to create an ultra-low-power memory device capable of storing and processing information in the same place. The bio-hybrid technology could eventually help make AI systems and next-generation computers far more energy efficient.
items.zh: 科学家将 DNA 转变为能耗降低 100 倍的存储设备

items.title: 'There's a sense that these algorithms are objective and they get to know you': How social media warps our understanding of healthcare

items.summary: Astronomers detected dust and water surprisingly close to the Milky Way's central black hole, Sagittarius A*, offering a rare direct view of how evolved stars may behave in hostile settings.
items.zh: 天文学家在银河系黑洞附近的恶劣环境中发现了水——本周太空照片

items.summary: Physicists may have uncovered a hidden feature inside protons that helps preserve one of matter’s most fundamental properties. items.summary: As we age, the body appears to sacrifice walking efficiency in exchange for stability. items.summary: Utility-scale solar leads by a mile, followed by batteries. Fossil fuels, not so much.
items.zh: 如此多的太阳能：深入研究今年上线的每家美国发电厂名单

items.title: How a brutal drought may have helped unleash yellow fever in Brazil
